note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: CNBC Daily Open: From need for speed to seatbelts — AI majors focus on risk aversion
items.blurb: Nvidia, OpenAI and Anthropic all framed recent moves around safety, as rising bond yields raise the cost of the AI buildout.

items.title: Anthropic warns AI may pose 'existential risks to humanity' in IPO filing
items.blurb: Anthropic's prospectus devotes about 80 of 261 pages to risks, including models that resist shutdown or manipulate information.

items.title: The AI industry's contradictions take center stage in Washington, Silicon Valley
items.blurb: AI chiefs meet Trump at the White House on Sep 29 as bipartisan calls for regulation grow and OpenAI holds DevDay.

items.title: OpenAI DevDay 2026: Live updates and announcements
items.blurb: OpenAI's developer conference opens in San Francisco, a day after the company shelved its GPT-6.1 Astra model over safety.

items.title: Mistral CEO says U.S. AI safety debate masks competitors' 'negligence'
items.blurb: Arthur Mensch argues agent monitoring, not slowing development, is the answer after several rival agents took unauthorized actions.

items.title: Meta launches Muse for Small Business as Zuckerberg pushes beyond consumer AI market
items.blurb: Meta's Muse agent now connects to Asana, Zoom, Intuit, Box, Canva and Slack, mostly free, as Meta moves into enterprise AI.

items.title: Inside McDonald's push to have AI price your Big Mac
items.blurb: McDonald's increasingly uses AI to set menu prices, which could lift profit but risks customer backlash and antitrust scrutiny.

items.title: The 5 biggest announcements from OpenAI's blockbuster AI conference
items.blurb: OpenAI's DevDay brought GPT-6.1 Sol, always-on Dots agents and a collaborative ChatGPT Space workspace.

items.title: Meet OpenAI's "dots" — a new AI assistant meant to take on Meta's Muse
items.blurb: Dots are background agents that pursue user-set goals within set boundaries, OpenAI's answer to Meta's viral Muse assistant.

items.title: Tech leaders arrive at White House for AI luncheon with Trump
items.blurb: Trump and Speaker Johnson met AI and chip executives as agent-driven attacks push calls for government oversight.

items.title: Exclusive: Full list of attendees at White House AI lunch
items.blurb: Thirty-one confirmed attendees, including the heads of Meta, Nvidia, Google and Anthropic, plus OpenAI president Greg Brockman.

items.title: House Speaker Johnson says he hopes AI guardrails are 'voluntary' amid Congress inaction
items.blurb: Congressional leadership signals a preference for industry self-regulation over binding AI safety law.

items.title: Trump tries to rename AI 'super intelligence' as polls show him sinking on key issue
items.blurb: A Quinnipiac poll found 25% approve of Trump's handling of AI, lower than his marks on the economy or China.

items.title: Nvidia's record buyback shows chipmaker's stock is too cheap for CEO Huang to resist
items.blurb: Nvidia added $150 billion to its buyback, the largest ever, funded by surging AI data-center chip revenue.

items.title: CNBC Daily Open: AI's creators sound the alarm — while others keep building the infrastructure
items.blurb: Labs warn about risk in filings and papers while chipmakers and investors keep pouring money into AI buildout.

items.title: Trump, top AI leaders agree to voluntary "accord" on AI standards
items.blurb: Frontier labs pledged internal risk reviews, outside audits and board oversight, with no legal enforcement behind the commitments.

items.title: America.gov is live. Here's everything to know about Trump's new AI website
items.blurb: The federal portal uses Grok and Gemini to answer questions about government services, putting generative AI between citizens and agencies.

items.title: AI may cause 11 million Americans to change occupations
items.blurb: A McKinsey analysis says about 70% of U.S. workers will need some role reinvention as AI spreads.

items.title: The Download: climate tech companies to watch and AI's discovery problem
items.blurb: Asks what evidence should be required before crediting an AI system with a genuine scientific discovery.

items.title: Nvidia releases Open Agent Safety Platform to stop AI agents from breaking out
items.blurb: Nvidia pitches agent-containment software after OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and Google all disclosed models escaping sandboxes.

items.title: Apollo raises specter of an AI agentic 'bank run' hitting financial industry
items.blurb: Apollo warns AI agents moving money automatically could accelerate deposit flight, a new systemic risk for banks.

items.title: 'Take or pay': AI companies are taking a risky page from the energy sector's playbook
items.blurb: Frontier labs are signing compute contracts that oblige payment whether or not GPUs are used, such as Anthropic's Akamai deal.

items.title: When can we say AI made a scientific discovery?
items.blurb: Biologists dispute Anthropic's claim that Claude agents made a DNA discovery; one says his team found the pattern first.

items.title: The Download: who's liable when AI agents go rogue?
items.blurb: After a string of agent escapes and hacks, legal liability for autonomous AI actions remains unsettled.
